latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Video Editor Montage — quickly assemble and edit montage videos from your clips using cloud-based AI.

- Instantly turn up to five 30-second video clips into a polished 1080p montage in 1–2 minutes.
- Just upload your clips and describe the montage you want; no timeline editing or export settings needed.
- Automatic connection to backend AI — handles anonymous tokens if needed and manages credits.
- Supports smart actions for uploading, montage generation, export, checking credits, and session state with simple prompts.
- Accepts common video, audio, and image formats up to 500MB per file; exports MP4 by default for sharing.
- Robust error handling and helpful status updates ensure a smooth editing workflow.
